findings.message: ~/.local/bin/swiftgate points at ~/.claude/plugins/cache/swift-harness/swift-harness/0.1.0/bin/swiftgate, not this harness (~/Developer/swift-harness-jev-live-end-to-end-check/plugin/bin/swiftgate); hooks run a different gate
SwiftLint is not installed; it is optional and style-only
mmdc (the Mermaid CLI) is not on PATH, so design-lint can't validate diagram syntax; install it with `npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`
no session record under .harness/hook-state/sessions, so doctor can't tell whether the plugin changed after this session started; the SessionStart hook writes one

[judge] backend = "jev" needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY, which isn't set here, so the judge can't ask jev: at ready its blocking questions go to claude and the advisory ones go unasked. Claude Code runs the gate in a non-interactive shell, so export TYPESAFE_API_KEY where one reads it (~/.zshenv, not ~/.zshrc), or set it under "env" in Claude Code's settings.json, then start a fresh session
